name: Cannon Charters
summary: A family-run sport fishing business working from Bridgetown on Cannon II, a 42 foot Hatteras with three fighting chairs. The captain and mate each have 25 years or more of experience, and deep water starts close to shore, so little time is spent getting to the fishing grounds. They also run a two hour turtle and shipwreck snorkel trip.
standouts: Captain and mate with 25 years or more of fishing experience
Cannon II, a 42 ft Hatteras with 3 fighting chairs
Transport to and from your hotel included on fishing charters

trips.title: Shared Fishing Charter
trips.summary: A four hour shared fishing trip on Cannon II, a 42 foot Hatteras, joining other anglers on the boat. Most fishing is by trolling for mahi mahi, wahoo and barracuda, and the mate helps first-timers. Friends who do not fish can come along as watchers for the ride and the coastline.
highlights: Mate on hand to teach beginners
trips.season: Year round; shared charters twice weekly

trips.title: Turtle Swim and Shipwreck Tour
trips.summary: A two hour boat trip to swim and snorkel with sea turtles and over a sunken shipwreck. Singles and couples join the shared tour, and families or groups can book the boat privately.
highlights: Meets at the Careenage by the Waterfront Café
